H,W = 160,256
def blockmap(mask):
    bh,bw = H//8, W//16
    out=[]
    for y in range(bh):
        line=''
        for x in range(bw):
            blk = mask[y*8:(y+1)*8, x*16:(x+1)*16]
            f=blk.mean()
            line += ' .:-=+*#%@'[min(9,int(f*10))]
        out.append(line)
    return '\\n'.join(out)
bright = ((r+g+b)/3 > 25)
print(blockmap(bright))
